annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Challenges and opportunities of artificial intelligence in the public sector: defining the role of regional and local authorities
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Challenges and opportunities of artificial intelligence in the public sector: defining the role of regional and local authorities
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the EU Committee of the Regions on AI in the public sector, stressing the role of local and regional authorities in ethical AI adoption. It welcomes the AI Act but calls for implementation guidelines, training, sandboxes, data spaces, funding and a European conformity certification system for public-sector AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for AI Act implementation guidelines for regional and local governments
Promotes EU-level regulatory sandboxes accessible to SMEs and startups
Suggests European conformity certification for AI tools used in public administrations
Calls for training, an 'Erasmus+ AI' programme for civil servants, and an AI observatory
Stresses human oversight, transparency and avoiding an AI gap between administrations
